tasks.short: Requisition merchandise using stock, space and demand.

steps.what: Gather stock levels, available space, customer demand and advertised specials.
Choose merchandise quantities and authorize the completed requisition.
Send the authorized merchandise requisition to the supplier.

tasks.design: Test native replenishment views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and requisition routing in {PROCUREMENT}. Combine current facts, let the stocker finalize quantities within delegated limits, then send that exact authorized version without retyping it in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock, promotion and supplier information require separate lookups and email entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Configurable views and requisition routing can connect already structured records.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual demand, shelf constraints and supplier minimums need local judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize upcoming demand that historic sales do not explain.

ambition.what: Revisit promotional replenishment quantities before each advertised offer starts.

tasks.altitude: Less preparation and sending; quantity authority stays within existing delegation.

reach.learn: Lead times, pack sizes and space constraints.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native requisition routing can send an authorized record without duplicate email entry.

assumptions: Boundary starts with gathering replenishment facts and ends at sending; supplier response and purchasing negotiation are outside and unchanged. Modeled stockers have delegated requisition authority.

Inventory staff supply item_id, location, on_hand, reserved_quantity, space_limit and timestamp; merchandising supplies dated promotions and demand history; purchasing supplies supplier_id, pack_size, minimum_quantity and lead_time. Missing data retain manual checks.

Native configuration first. Authorized requisition v1 binds supplier, lines, units, quantities and requested date; edits invalidate authorization. Sending failure returns to the stocker, with exception time allowed as upkeep.
unknowns: Delegated limits and native routing support.
research_questions: Can the route prevent duplicate sends and reject changed authorized records?

incremental.description: Resolve failed sends and report stale replenishment inputs.

approvals.approved_version: authorized requisition v1: supplier, lines, units, quantities and requested date; any edit voids authorization

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=62.5 gross=37.5 net=35.5 after 2 upkeep. Low: fragmented promotion data and failed routing; high: clean inputs and reliable sending. Quantity judgement retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read incoming requisitions and establish item quantities and collection locations.
Collect the requested materials, products, parts or supplies.
Issue collected merchandise to the named customer or coworker.

tasks.design: Test native issue-list views in {OPS_SYSTEM} to show item, quantity, recipient and location together. Keep collection and physical distribution unchanged; the benefit is shorter instruction lookup rather than faster lifting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Printed requisitions may omit current locations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native location-linked issue views can show the same requested lines with fewer lookups.
tasks.still_hard: Missing stock, inaccessible locations and recipient identification.
tasks.human_edge: Detect a physically wrong item before handing it over.
tasks.altitude: A little less instruction lookup; issue authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare collected items for protected handover.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: location-linked issue lists can shorten instruction reading while leaving goods movement intact.

assumptions: Boundary is requisition interpretation through physical issue, excluding requisition approval and separate stock-record maintenance.

Requesting team supplies requisition_id, item_id, quantity, unit and recipient; inventory controller supplies current location. Missing fields require manual clarification; paper requisitions use manual item selection, not guessed extraction.
Native view configuration first; access and national employee consultation are included where applicable. Collection and handover retain their full shares.
unknowns: How many requisitions lack valid item or location data.
research_questions: Does the combined view reduce instruction lookup without increasing wrong-item issues?

incremental.description: Report stale locations or missing request fields.
Maintain location records and view permissions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92.5 gross=7.5 net=7 after 0.5 upkeep. Low: requests already complete; high: frequent location lookups. Physical collection and issue are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read orders to determine merchandise variants and quantities.

steps.what: Retrieve the current orders and their merchandise line details.
Read catalog numbers, sizes, colors and quantities and clarify ambiguous lines.

tasks.design: Test a native {OPS_SYSTEM} pick view with separate catalogue number, size, colour, quantity and unit columns. Load only the current released order version and highlight missing variants; the stocker confirms requirements rather than decoding prose.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dense printed lines make variants and units difficult to distinguish.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured order lines can be displayed consistently without model interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Free-text requests and obsolete catalogue variants require clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when the described variant conflicts with the requested use or item identity.
tasks.altitude: Less decoding of orders; picking and substitution rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Flag incomplete order lines before dispatch preparation.
reach.learn: Order-release states and catalogue variant rules.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured pick views reduce document retrieval and decoding, provided variant data already exist.

assumptions: Boundary is reading already released orders, excluding their creation, physical picking and issue. This action is not counted again under incoming internal requisitions.

Order team supplies order_id, version, release_state, line_id, item_id, catalogue_number, size, colour, quantity and unit; catalogue owner supplies variant mappings. Free-text or paper lines retain manual reading and clarification, with no assumed automatic extraction.
Native display configuration first. Central savings assume mainly structured orders; existing system runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Structured-order coverage and actual decoding time.
research_questions: Can staff identify every required variant and unit from the view alone?

already_counted.description: Check variants and clarify ambiguous lines.

incremental.description: Flag variant mapping defects and order-version problems.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=30 gross=70 net=69 after 1 upkeep. Low: substantial prose and paper orders; high: structured variants with occasional clarification. No physical picking saving is included.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend disposal of excess, defective or obsolete stock.

steps.what: Examine excess, defective or obsolete stock and note its condition.
Check stock age, demand and return options for the identified items.
Recommend disposal or an alternative and explain the reasons to the supervisor.

tasks.design: Test a native aged-stock view in {OPS_SYSTEM} with links to current disposal and supplier-return guidance in {DOCS}. The stocker examines the goods and recommends a route; actual write-off authorization and destruction remain outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock age and return options require separate searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing stock-history views can gather those facts by item.
tasks.still_hard: Safety, contamination and uncertain resale value need accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish damaged packaging from unusable goods and explain uncertainty.

ambition.what: Review returnable slow-moving items before supplier return deadlines expire.

tasks.altitude: Less fact gathering; recommendation rights stay the same and disposal authority is not gained.

reach.task: Identify the appropriate handling route for rejected stock.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: age and movement views can support disposal recommendations without judging physical condition.

assumptions: Boundary ends at recommendation. Write-off approval, stock adjustment and physical disposal are excluded and unchanged, so no execution approval is modeled.

Inventory controller supplies item_id, lot_id, received_date, last_movement, quantity and cost; purchasing supplies return_deadline and return_terms; safety owner supplies disposal guidance. Missing records require manual checks and explicit uncertainty.
Native reporting first. No automatic destruction decision or speculative resale valuation is proposed.
unknowns: Availability of lot age, returns terms and condition categories.
research_questions: Does the joined view reveal return options without encouraging premature disposal?

incremental.description: Report missing return terms or age records.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=87.5 gross=12.5 net=11.5 after 1 upkeep. Low: fragmented lot records; high: reliable history. Physical examination and recommendation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Spend less time gathering stock facts and decoding orders, while retaining physical checks and stock recommendations.
role.ambitious_version: A stocker who catches unclear orders and expiring return options before they create avoidable stock problems.
